svg.title: Catch-up — judging a block, then proposing where it goes

g.text: Catch-up — judging a block, then proposing where it goes
every block re-judges on next read,
need = shortfall, snapped to the 30-min grid
prefer the original time of day
a free gap >= need, before the deadline?
less than you owed — you decide if it's enough
the user picks the victim, never the app
an unworked block big enough exists?
the deadline is the wrong constraint
an honest dead end beats a fake placement
